dict.string: Cénit connects directly to your WHOOP strap over Bluetooth to read heart rate, R-R intervals, battery, and sensor data locally on your iPhone. Nothing leaves your device.
Cénit crosses your calendar events with your day's stress, on your iPhone, to show what your most activated moments coincided with. Nothing leaves your device.
Cénit crosses your calendar events with your day's stress, on your iPhone, to show what your most activated moments coincided with. Nothing leaves your device.
Cénit reads your own Apple Health data on-device to compute recovery, strain, and sleep. Nothing leaves your device.
Cénit writes the metrics it computes from your strap back into Apple Health, on-device and only when you allow it.
Cénit saves the workout card you choose to share to your photo library. It only saves the image you explicitly ask it to.
